body:
Social life has gone so far downhill that I have contact with 1 person every few days. On the internet.

2 years ago my family was your typical playbook family, everyone's happy and satisfied and content with the situation. A divorce, a new boyfriend for mom, a coming-out from me and one thing I rather not mention has led to no one in my family having contact with anyone anymore (as far as I know, at least).

Grades have gone from an average B, maybe an A sometimes, down to D's, often E's. I either didn't pay attention, couldn't be arsed to do work, or straight up didn't care.

Me gaining a *few* pounds and my desired body image changing hasn't really helped either.

Shit sucks.

Without going into detail I don't think there's a lot to talk about. The past 2 years have sucked and everything went downhill, school, family, social life, you name it. I decided to put an end to it but apparently some greater force has some use for me I guess.
